title: Cinematic Respawn
body:
# Cinematic Respawn

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ulx2tj5t6Wc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

_Cinematic Respawn replaces the vanilla death screen with a smooth cinematic transition._

### Features

- Hides the vanilla death screen
- Automatic respawn
- Skip key
- Fully client-side
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

_Cinematic Respawn is designed to make death feel less abrupt while keeping the normal Minecraft respawn flow intact._

P.S.
> This is a client-side visual mod.
